pediatricPearls: Use pediatric dosing of medications or electrical therapy for a pediatric patient < 37 kg and as defined by the PEDIA Tape.
Focus on rapid and early BLS airway and ventilation. Intubation may not be the best
If HR <60 and age ≤1 yr , be gi n CPR
Pediatric pads should be used in children < 10 Kg or PEDIA tape color purple.
Seizure, syncope or shock secondary to bradycardia.

pl1: If pediatric and HR < 60 with poor perfusion despite oxygenation & ventilation, begin Pit Crew CPR
4 lead and 12 lead ECG placement and acquisition
pl2: Isotonic Crystalloid PRN titrated to SBP > 90 mmHg or MAP > 65
pl3: Glucagon in setting of Beta Blocker OD or Calcium Channel Blocker OD
If Adult: Epinephrine infusion titrated to MAP > 65
If Pediatric: Epinephrine infusion titrated to patient presentation
